pages.title: Check Your Stats
pages.text: Open your inventory ($(k:inventory)) and click the $(bold)Show Attributes$() button next to your character model.$(br2)The panel lists every number on you — armor, toughness, knockback resist, spell power, mana, cooldowns — and hovering a line breaks it down into base value and modifiers.$(br2)$(note)Provided by Apothic Attributes.$()
